description: This file defines the Chromium class extending BrowserType, implementing methods for launching, connecting, and managing Chromium browser instances within the Playwright project. It includes logic for handling CDP connections, Selenium hub integration, and startup log rewriting.

classes.name: Chromium
classes.description: Represents the Chromium browser type with methods to launch, connect, and manage Chromium browser instances, including CDP and Selenium integration.

methods.name: launch
methods.description: Launches a Chromium browser instance with specified options.

methods.name: launchPersistentContext
methods.description: Creates a persistent browser context with user data directory.

methods.name: connectOverCDP
methods.description: Connects to a Chromium instance over the Chrome DevTools Protocol.

methods.name: _connectOverCDPImpl
methods.description: Internal implementation for establishing a CDP connection with cleanup logic.

methods.name: connectOverCDPTransport
methods.description: Connects to a Chromium instance over an existing transport.

methods.name: _createDevTools
methods.description: Creates a CRDevTools instance if available.

methods.name: connectToTransport
methods.description: Connects to a Chromium transport, handling profile conflicts.

methods.name: doRewriteStartupLog
methods.description: Rewrites startup logs to provide clearer error messages.

methods.name: amendEnvironment
methods.description: Amends environment variables for Chromium process.

methods.name: attemptToGracefullyCloseBrowser
methods.description: Sends a command to gracefully close the browser.

methods.name: _launchWithSeleniumHub
methods.description: Launches Chromium via Selenium Hub with capabilities and session management.

methods.name: defaultArgs
methods.description: Generates default command-line arguments for launching Chromium.

methods.name: _innerDefaultArgs
methods.description: Constructs the core set of command-line arguments based on options.

methods.name: waitForReadyState
methods.description: Waits for the browser to be ready and retrieves WebSocket endpoint.

methods.name: getExecutableName
methods.description: Determines the executable name based on options.
